source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Symptoms limited mainly to the respiratory system, rather than the broader signs cirrhosis is actually known to cause","B":"Fairly few detectable clinical findings at all, since cirrhosis is often assumed to remain asymptomatic in every client","C":"Jaundice, ascites, spider angiomas, and palmar erythema, among other signs reflecting impaired liver function and portal hypertension","D":"An improvement in the client's overall skin tone with fairly little palpable abdominal finding on exam"}}
source_row.rationale: Characteristic clinical signs of cirrhosis include jaundice, ascites, spider angiomas, and palmar erythema, among other signs, reflecting the combined effects of impaired liver function and portal hypertension characteristic of this condition.
